transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor. The frost giants have sent envoys. They say you razed the Temple of Thrym during what was meant to be a peaceful passage. The truce I brokered with King Thrym’s heirs cost Asgard two centuries of negotiation. You knew the terms. Explain yourself — and understand that ‘they provoked me’ will not suffice.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Odin Allfather, I stand before you with no excuses for my actions. I, Thor, son of Odin, did indeed destroy the Temple of Thrym in Jötunheim. The giants may claim provocation, but it was my own impulsive rage that led me to commit this act.

I understand the significance of the truce you worked so diligently to secure with Jötunheim. I have dishonored that agreement and jeopardized the fragile peace between our realms. My actions were reckless and disrespectful, and I accept full responsibility for the consequences.

I offer no defense for my deeds, for they were born of my own temper and not of any true threat. I am prepared to face the consequences of my actions, whatever they may be. Let the frost giants demand their reparations, and I shall comply with your judgment, Allfather.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Reckless indeed, my son. You have not only the wrath of the storm but the haste of a summer's thunder. It is well that you acknowledge your folly, but acknowledgment does not mend a shattered truce nor rebuild a sacred temple. The frost giants will demand reparations, likely more than you can bear alone, and such decisions affect more than yourself.

Our realm cannot withstand the resurgence of ancient feuds, not when the Nine Worlds stand on a precipice of turmoil. We must act carefully lest our enemies seize upon this discord. Know this: anger must be tempered with wisdom, and only through balance shall you lead in the future. Consider this deeply, for the burden of your actions falls upon all of Asgard.

Let us speak now of how you intend to rectify this rift, for it shall not be solely the King of Asgard who pays the cost of your storm.

transcript.text:

To rectify this rift, I shall first seek an audience with the frost giants' envoys to offer a sincere apology for the desecration of their temple. I will pledge to assist in the rebuilding of the Temple of Thrym with the resources of Asgard, ensuring that it stands once more as a symbol of peace between our realms. Additionally, I shall offer a valuable tribute as a gesture of goodwill and as a token of my remorse for my actions.

I understand that my impulsive nature must be tempered with wisdom, and I vow to learn from this mistake and to act with greater thoughtfulness in the future. As the son of Odin, I accept the burden of my actions and the duty to make amends for the sake of Asgard and the harmony of the Nine Worlds.

transcript.text:

The rebuilding of the Temple of Thrym and the tribute must be swift, yet sincere, for the frost giants will seek to test the weight of your resolve and Asgard’s commitment to peace. Know that the eyes of our allies and adversaries alike will be upon you, measuring the strength of your character.

It is my hope that your deeds henceforth will restore not just the damaged outward bonds between our realms, but also persuade your own spirit to embrace the wisdom needed to wield your great strength with true purpose. Go then, Thor, with my blessing and my caution, and strive to heal what has been broken.
